commit.message:
fix(security): validate disposition paths explicitly

Resolve explicit CLI file selections inside the workspace before
reading either input, while keeping repository-owned default paths.
Document the boundary for alternate historical fixtures.

fix(security): validate disposition paths explicitly

Resolve explicit CLI file selections inside the workspace before
reading either input, while keeping repository-owned default paths.
Document the boundary for alternate historical fixtures.
fix(testing): require Parties evidence and validate native scope

test(module): cover scoped native identity, endpoint channel refusal and readiness preparation outputs

- Assert a prepared native scope that differs from the fallback reaches the
  decoded HEXALITH_G4_ACCESS_TOKEN claims (domains, tenants,
  eventstore:surface=agent) and the sorted HEXALITH_G4_DOMAINS handoff.
- Refuse an unsafe or inconsistent endpoint-credential channel (missing file,
  group-readable mode, foreign run id, endpoints without path) with HXT008 at
  the executor before the child launches, beside a launched valid control.
- Publish a registered ICompositionRunPreparation's native scope, bound
  invocation endpoint and fixed credential path into readiness, and refuse
  endpoints without path, path without endpoints and a path outside the
  workspace without publishing readiness.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

+namespace Hexalith.Builds.ModuleTool.Tests.Workspace;
+
+using Hexalith.Builds.Tooling.Runtime;
+
+/// <summary>Reports fixed owner preparation outputs so readiness publication can be observed without live services.</summary>
+/// <param name="scope">The owner-derived native scope.</param>
+/// <param name="endpoints">The metadata-only invocation endpoints.</param>
+/// <param name="credentialsPath">The private endpoint credential channel path, or null when none is prepared.</param>
+internal sealed class PreparedOutputsRunPreparation(CompositionNativeTestScope? scope, IReadOnlyList<CompositionNativeHttpEndpoint> endpoints, string? credentialsPath) : ICompositionRunPreparation
+{
+    /// <inheritdoc/>
+    public CompositionNativeTestScope? NativeTestScope => scope;
+
+    /// <inheritdoc/>
+    public IReadOnlyList<CompositionNativeHttpEndpoint> NativeHttpEndpoints => endpoints;
+
+    /// <inheritdoc/>
+    public string? NativeEndpointCredentialsPath => credentialsPath;
+
+    /// <inheritdoc/>
+    public Task PrepareAsync(IServiceProvider services, CancellationToken cancellationToken) => Task.CompletedTask;
+}
